'''Frederick Ealick ONYX The Rock Hard Deck v 1 0''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Frederick Ealick]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-12527">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12527 ONYX The Rock Hard Deck v 1 0], DeckTech (Frederick "mist _hunter" Ealick, 25 December 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/12527/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/12527/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018081740/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12527/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Frederick Ealick]]
* '''Published:''' 25 December 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''ONYX The Rock Hard Deck v 1 0''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif|label=Endor Operations}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 EOps Ealick DS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This deck uses heavy ground to help flip Endor Operations. If your opponent attacks your ground forces, react with your many speeder bikes for huge power.If they attack your space, they will be in for a heavy beating.

== Original post ==

'''ONYX The Rock Hard Deck v 1 0'''
* '''Author:''' Frederick "mist _hunter" Ealick
* '''Published:''' December 25, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This deck uses heavy ground to help flip Endor Operations. If your opponent attacks your ground forces, react with your many speeder bikes for huge power.If they attack your space, they will be in for a heavy beating.

=== Strategy ===

==== DECK EDIT ====

START>>>> I need to add some good ground interrupts, but don't have the room, i'm aware that the space is really overpowered, but EBO is big here and I need to be prepared. <<<<DECK EDIT END

Your overpowered Endor Operations deck here. Deploy speeder bikes and pilots for heavy defense. Grab Establish Secret Base first, then Ominous Rumors so that you don't spread out too far. Combat Response will pull you many good ships and their pilots so that they can help your space armada destroy the traitorous legions of the vile rebels. Oh yeah, I almost forgot, the main point of this deck is not winning, but coming in first place. Therefore, have fun while you pick your opponents valued Home One apart by a well placed Intruder Missle (evil laugh)
